 if p not in initial['allowed_tracked']:assert sha((R/p).read_bytes())==h,p

assert sha(v1.encode())==d['incidents'][0]['v1_source_sha256']

 raw=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(meta['raw_log_gzip_base64']))

import base64,datetime,gzip,hashlib,json,os,shutil,stat,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
R=Path('/opt/platform/fridadev');P=R/'app/docs/states/baselines/document-workshop/frida-v1-document-workshop-m4-image-focus-fix-20261010.json'
d=json.loads(P.read_text());E=Path(d['cleanup']['root'])
assert E==Path('/tmp/fridadev-obs-m4-focus-fix-20261010') and E.resolve()==E and not E.is_symlink()
assert E.lstat().st_uid==os.getuid() and stat.S_ISDIR(E.lstat().st_mode)
assert d['initial']['owned_root_initially_absent'] and d['precommit']['before_cleanup']['status']=='passed'
assert d['cleanup']['status']=='pending'
assert subprocess.check_output(['docker','ps','-aq','--filter','label=fridadev.proof=obs-m4-focus-fix-20261010'],text=True).strip()==''
manifest=[]
for f in sorted(E.iterdir()):
 assert not f.is_symlink() and stat.S_ISREG(f.lstat().st_mode),f
 raw=f.read_bytes();text=raw.decode();key=f.stem
 if f.name in d['proof_programs']:
  assert text==d['proof_programs'][f.name]['source'];location='proof_programs.'+f.name
 elif f.name=='probe_fix_v1.js':
  assert text==d['proof_programs']['probe_fix.js']['source'].replace('/proof/control/test-without-wait.js','/proof/test-without-wait.js');location='incidents[0].v1_source_derivation'
 elif f.suffix=='.log' and key in d['runs']:
  assert raw==gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(d['runs'][key]['raw_log_gzip_base64']));location='runs.'+key+'.raw_log_gzip_base64'
 elif f.suffix=='.json' and key in d['runs']:
  assert all(d['runs'][key][k]==v for k,v in json.loads(text).items());location='runs.'+key+' (original metadata subset)'
 elif f.name=='initial.json':
  assert json.loads(text)==d['initial'];location='initial'
 elif f.name in ('test-before.js','test-without-wait.js'):
  assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==d['patch']['before_sha256'];location='immutable initial HEAD:'+d['patch']['file']
 elif f.name.endswith('-argv.json'):
  label=f.name.removesuffix('-argv.json');assert json.loads(text)==d['runs'][label]['argv'];location='runs.'+label+'.argv'
 elif f.name=='effective-isolation.json':
  assert json.loads(text)==d['isolation']['effective_m4'];location='isolation.effective_m4'
 else:raise AssertionError('Owned file not durably preserved: '+f.name)
 manifest.append({'name':f.name,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'durable_location':location})
d['cleanup']={'status':'removal_in_progress','root':str(E),'manifest':manifest,'preservation_verified_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'owned_containers_absent':True,'scope':'only this exclusively owned root; no shared cache or foreign resource removed','host_sockets':'none created; browser processes/sockets lived in disposable container tmpfs'}
P.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
shutil.rmtree(E);assert not E.exists() and not E.is_symlink()
d['cleanup']['status']='removed_verified';d['cleanup']['verified_absent_utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
P.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':'removed_verified','root':str(E),'archived_files':len(manifest),'owned_containers_absent':True,'shared_caches_preserved':True}))
